description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for rendering content as text within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles content rendering, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

classes.name: RenderContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to render content as text, with support for editing links and XML escaping.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that renders content based on template arguments, handling content retrieval, XML escaping, and optional edit link wrapping.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Performs the actual content rendering, handling locale, XML escaping, and error logging.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Wraps content in a div with a specified edit style.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Closes the edit wrapper by adding an edit link.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Determines the CSS style for the edit wrapper, defaulting to 'buttontext'.
